about: One graph format for data, queries and structure (editor spec §27, mesh_one_format). One GQL block holds a graph's schema and its inserts. It is read once, and one query engine (the lens rules of §15) answers about its things and about its schema, link types included. lensBuckets (packages/graph-spec/src/rules/lenses.js) and lens_buckets (python/graph_spec/src/graphspec/rules/lens.py) give these answers alike.
block: (link_uses:Meta:ElementType {name: 'USES', kind: 'edge', origin: 'source', reading: 'uses', reverse_name: 'is used by'}),

cases.name: the things the block inserts answer a query
cases.lens: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.id AS id, CASE WHEN p.price > 10 THEN 'dear' ELSE 'cheap' END AS grp

cases.name: the schema in the same block answers the same engine, its link types included
cases.lens: MATCH (t:ElementType) RETURN t.id AS id, CASE WHEN t.kind = 'edge' THEN 'link' ELSE 'thing' END AS grp
